subject.title: fix(webchat): preserve session context on first send after page load (#96331)

question: Should WebChat treat a successfully loaded history-backed session as a one-shot private resume signal so the next send continues that visible session even when idle/daily freshness would otherwise rotate it?
rationale: The docs and user report support continuity after page refresh, but this deliberately changes session freshness behavior for the first send after history load and should be accepted by a session-state owner before merge.

options.title: Accept Loaded-History Continuity
options.body: Port the fix to the current modules and treat a matching history-loaded session as the intended WebChat continuation behavior.

options.title: Keep Reset-First Freshness
options.body: Do not add the resume marker after ordinary history load; instead design a stale-session disclosure or explicit restore action for WebChat.

options.title: Defer Until Live Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a fresh WebChat restart/page-load proof on the current split UI before choosing policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Loaded-History Continuity
recommendation.body: Port the fix to the current modules and treat a matching history-loaded session as the intended WebChat continuation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and the recent split Control UI module layout make this the best available owner for the current-file policy decision.
